signature.name: Monas
signature.detail: Jakarta's most famous landmark, the National Monument, topped with a flame and set in a large central park. It is the symbol of the city and a must for first-time visitors. Go early in the morning to avoid heat and crowds, and note the monument is often closed on Mondays.

signature.name: Istiqlal Mosque
signature.detail: Southeast Asia's largest mosque and a striking modern landmark right by Monas. Visitors can tour the prayer halls outside prayer times. Dress modestly and cover shoulders and legs; robes are often available at the entrance.

signature.name: Kota Tua Jakarta
signature.detail: The old Dutch colonial quarter with historic buildings, squares and museums, best explored on foot. Come in the morning or late afternoon for cooler weather and better light. It is easily reached by train to Jakarta Kota station.

transport: TransJakarta bus or MRT around $0.30-1; taxis and ride-hailing cheap
